text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zaire Province governor Ludy Kissassunda recently met traditional authorities in the province over the peace process and their continued cooperation with the extension of state administration. The capital of the province, Zaire M'Banza Congo, is the first city to be turned over to the government by UNITA.
- Domingos da Cruz Sebastiao, director of Luanda's international airport, announced that it would be modernised in the coming months.
